jgarbers@netcom.com (Jeff Garbers) writes:

>Okay, here's a real simple one... what's the official WotC pronunciation
>of "Jyhad"? I've been saying "zhee-HAHD" ("zh" being the trailing sound
>in "rouge"). I've heard others say "JIE-hadd" ("J" as in "Jello", "JIE"
>to rhyme with "LIE"). I'm waiting for a fellow Georgia resident to
>say "GEE-haid", so as to rhyme with "YEE-haw", sort of.

>So, what's the word? Hard or soft J? Accent on first or last syllable?

I pronounce it just like the Islamic Holy War, Ji-had (a with umlaut)
